Once a lion was sleeping in a forest. Suddenly a mouse came there. It was, in fact, playing on a race quite happily and didn't notice the sleeping lion. While running he suddenly slip into lion's nose. The lion woke up and became very angry and about to kill that mouse. Then the mouse told the lion to let him go. He also said that he will help the lion in future if he let him go.

The lion laughed so hard and said that, how a mere mouse can help him. Then the lion let the mouse go. After that incident, several days passed. One day, the lion was walking into the forest and fell in a hunter's net trap. Then he started roaring for help but no one came. Then the mouse arrived and told the lion ~~the~~ that he will help him. The lion asked how a little thing can help him. Then the rat started cutting the net by his sharp teeth. After some time, the mouse set the lion free. The lion became very happy and thanked the mouse for his help. From that day, that lion and mouse became best friends.
